clusters.headline: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina Seeks Passport For Return To BD
aiSummaryBullets: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has applied for a new passport, which sources from her party suggest indicates plans to return in December.
The interim government in Bangladesh has characterized these reports as political posturing, claiming there is no actual intent to return.

clusters.headline: Bangladesh Garment Sector Faces Labor Unrest Amid Economic Strain
aiSummaryBullets: Garment employees in Bangladesh are curtailing expenditures on nutrition and medical services due to insufficient earnings.
Recent labor demonstrations have escalated into violence in several manufacturing locations.
